summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new API-based marketplace/loja endpoints and the auto-sync error banner. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering /category-mapping/lojas, /gaps, /marketplaces, /new-count, /previews, /sync-new (POST) and /sync-new/status. Frontend: dropdown correctly lists 7 options (Todos marketplaces + Mercado Livre + Shopee + 4 Loja(...)), sourced from the Bling API (not from the empty Playwright cache). Auto-sync error banner (data-testid='autosync-error-banner') renders as expected when run status = 'error' and hides while running or done — banner shows the full Playwright timeout, the 'Diagnóstico' explanation and the mention of bling.com.br.
critical_code_review_comments: category_mapping.py list_gaps() re-fetches /categorias/lojas a second time (via a fresh paginated loop inside list_gaps) after list_bling_lojas() already paginated the same endpoint. For 6 lojas / 128 categories this is fine, but the two loops should share a single fetch — extract a helper _fetch_lojas_raw() that returns the flat list and reuse it in both list_bling_lojas() and list_gaps() to halve API round-trips.

_guess_marketplace_name() labels the 4 numeric-code lojas as 'Loja (100291)', 'Loja (21462)', etc. These are likely valid Bling loja types the user recognizes (Kwai, Nuvemshop, Tray, etc). Consider persisting a manual override map (loja_id -> display_name) in Mongo so the user can rename these 'Loja (xxxx)' to their real marketplace names via the UI.
server.py is now ~730 lines (pre-existing concern flagged in iter_5 & iter_6). Splitting category-mapping routes into routers/category_mapping.py is overdue.

CategoryMapping.js loadMarketplaces() catches the /lojas error silently (only logger.error) but does not surface a user-facing toast. If the Bling API itself is down (502 from our endpoint), the user gets the same 'Todos marketplaces' dropdown with no explanation — consider a small warning strip when /lojas fails.
test_credentials: N/A — Bling access already configured in backend/.env (bling_service.bling_request works).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests hit the live Bling account attached to backend/.env (read-only /categorias/lojas + /categorias/produtos calls).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /lojas endpoint currently returns 6 lojas (2 named 'Shopee' + 'Mercado Livre', 4 labeled 'Loja (xxxxx)' due to numeric codes). The Playwright sync-new/scan flow WILL fail in this container (bling.com.br is unreachable — 60s timeout); that's the diagnostic message intentionally shown in the error banner. Do NOT try to make Playwright work; test the API-based flows only. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_category_mapping_lojas_gaps.py (9 tests, ~10s).
rca of the issue: Original bug had two roots: (1) marketplace dropdown was fed only by /marketplaces which reads category_mapping_trees Mongo collection populated by Playwright scans that could never complete in this container — collection was empty so dropdown showed only 'Todos marketplaces'. (2) sync-new failed silently because Playwright cannot reach bling.com.br from this container. Fix: (a) new /lojas endpoint bypasses Playwright and reads Bling's official /categorias/lojas API — validated 6 lojas returned including Shopee + Mercado Livre; (b) frontend merges /lojas + /marketplaces so users always see connected marketplaces; (c) new error banner surfaces the Playwright failure with a clear 'Diagnóstico' about the network limitation. All three fixes verified working end-to-end.
